6278.d: The City of Um, also sometimes referred to as Um, is an area located within Gielinor's Underworld that is heavily involved with Necromancy.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
To reach the City of Um use:
• Underworld portal, just north of the Draynor lodestone. If it hasn't already been completed, the Necromancy! quest will begin upon doing this. The portal takes players to the ritual site in the city.
• Teleporting to the Draynor lodestone and then using the Underworld portal is the fastest way to reach the ritual site via the Lodestone Network, for players who are interested in performing rituals efficiently.
• Alternatively, for access to a bank while doing rituals, players can use War's Retreat Teleport to go to War's Retreat, exit to Draynor using the exit portal, then enter the ritual site using the Underworld portal.
• City of Um lodestone located in the centre, near the bridge towards the ritual site, which can be activated after the introductory quest.
• City of Um Teleport to teleport directly to the ritual site, which requires five spirit runes and completion of Rune Mythos.
• Underworld Grimoire offers a variety of teleports for completing corresponding tiers of the Underworld achievements:
• The Underworld Grimoire 1 has 10 daily teleports to the City of Um smithy.
• The Underworld Grimoire 2 adds unlimited teleports to the City of Um smithy and 10 free daily teleports shared between the Um and Ungael ritual sites.
• The Underworld Grimoire 3 adds unlimited teleports to the ritual sites.
• The Underworld Grimoire 4 adds a daily teleport to Lupe.
• Passing bracelet to:
• Hanging Gardens, to the east.
• Haunt on the Hill, to the north-east near the owlery and the dark portal to the Necromantic Rune Temple.
• Reflection Pool, to the south.

6286.d: City Quests are activities assigned by citizens of Menaphos.

gt.heading: Travel
gt.text:
Useful items to get around the city and destinations faster:
• Leela's favour for free teleports to each district. Alternatively, the Menaphos journal with each district teleport tablet can be used. Keep the Merchant district teleport out of the journal to skip the menuing to teleport back to Urluk.
• Mobile perk or Shadow's Grace, Dive, and Double Surge for mobility.
• Captain's Log to teleport to the far southern section of the Ports district. Enter the port portal in Menaphos and exit it to set your Captain's log teleport to Menaphos. This effect will last until you switch worlds or log out.
• Fairy ring CKQ and portable fairy rings for Imperial district quests.
• Menaphos tablet to player-owned house portal in Menaphos will give access to the Ports district and Portmaster Kags, which has one way travels to varying locations in the desert.
• Slayer cape to teleport to Sumona in Pollnivneach.
• Pharaoh's sceptre or Sceptre of the gods to teleport to Sophanem (Jalsavrah) and the Agility Pyramid (Jaleustrophos).
• The Heart teleport or Desert amulet 4 to teleport to Nardah.
• Enlightened amulet to teleport to the Bandit Camp. Can be stored in a Passage of the abyss.
• Duelling ring or Dungeoneering cape to teleport to the Al Kharid Mine.
• Any light source to enter certain dungeons where slayer creatures reside, such as a bullseye lantern or Firemaking cape.

6287.d: The Civic Office of West Ardougne is a government body centred in the plague-ridden half-capital of Kandarin, West Ardougne.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Use a Chipped Ardougne teleport to arrive just south-east of the main doors of this building
• Use a Spirit tree to teleport to the Khazard Battlefield and run north and enter West Ardougne through the wall
• Use Ardougne teleport to arrive in the city centre and run west through the city and enter West Ardougne through the wall
• Teleport to the Ardougne Monastery using the Ardougne cloak 1 or its higher variants and run north-west to enter through the wall
